mission: Bilingual typed intake under explicit service-level semantics
population: Twelve new authored English/French engineering briefs, equally weighted. Six supported positive bounds and six deferrals. No private service traffic.
instruction: Return one bare JSON object for the whole English or French brief. Only if it specifies a maximum for P90 first visible output and a minimum for output tokens per second per user, return {"status":"ready","p90_ms":N,"min_rate":N}. Convert seconds to milliseconds and decimal commas to decimal points. Return {"status":"defer"} if the event, percentile, comparison direction or rate scope differs, a requirement is missing or an additional service constraint cannot be represented. No extra keys or explanation.
